scope: Form 30-derived questions only (gold_runtime ids starting with form30_page-)

structuralChecks: validated every Form 30 runtime row has a correct_answer within option range
validated every Form 30 runtime correct_answer points to an option whose id and letter match the 1-based answer index
validated Form 30 items embedded in artifacts/exports/test1_exam.json and artifacts/exports/test2_exam.json have internally consistent correctAnswer.index and correctAnswer.letter values
manualAdjudication: reviewed the 20 Form 30 rows listed in artifacts/evals/session45_answer_audit.json as OE/runtime mismatches
manually checked representative high-risk rows against the actual runtime stem/options/explanation and, where present, source-linked image metadata
sourceLimitations: no local Form 30 PDF or official answer-key artifact was present in the repo during this audit
existing session45 audit artifacts rely on an external OE comparison and were not treated as source truth

otherFindings.summary: The session45 artifact appears to mis-map 1-based answer indexes to letters/option numbers for Form 30 rows, producing false OE/runtime mismatch signals.
otherFindings.impact: This is evidence against using session45 as proof that Form 30 qbank keys are wrong. It does not, by itself, show a defect in gold_runtime.json.

recommendedNextAction: If you want stronger source-of-truth verification beyond repo-internal consistency and manual content adjudication, add the actual Form 30 source PDF and/or official answer key artifact to the repo, then rerun a form-scoped comparison directly against those sources.
